error[ZBX-E0316]: a --sysctl is a host setting
  while  reading --sysctl
  cause  vm.max_map_count is a host setting, not one of the container's own
         namespaces, so a container can't set it
  sysctl vm.max_map_count
  fix    set it on the host instead:               sudo sysctl -w vm.max_map_count=<value>
         or refuse the run on a host without it:   --require-host 'vm.max_map_count>=<value>'
         the keys a container may set:             zbx explain E0316
  more   zbx explain E0316
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0316.html
